baseline: preserved pre-optimization build including Min hair and Nara/Sora/Leo fills; localhost4197
method: Same current practice including hair fixes; alternating 4 paired rounds, 120 fixed steps +15 measured actual WebGL draws after 120-step/10-draw warmup. ProcessTime renderer CPU, forced-GC retained JS heap. Readback/quality draw outside CPU interval. Not total app CPU/FPS/GPU/RAM.
notes: Each workload has one CPU regression sample; medians are workload observations, not a guaranteed saving.
Forced-GC JS heap is similar; no RAM/RSS/GPU/whole-system CPU saving claim.
roundWallMs includes post-measure quality work and is not used as CPU percentage denominator.
First-iteration exploratory performance is excluded and retained only in ignored .data.
Final failure-only change releases the retired ScenarioPlayer reference; it does not alter measured active-render workloads.
